result.summary: The food delivery home screen has several layout and content issues: duplicated restaurant cards, a truncated restaurant name, a category chip cut off at the screen edge, and a promo card clipped at the bottom.

issues.description: The first two 'Fastest near you' cards are identical (same image, name 'Green Bowl Poké', time, and delivery fee), which looks like a data or rendering bug.
issues.suggestion: Ensure each card maps to a unique restaurant and remove duplicate items from the list.

issues.description: The third restaurant name is truncated to 'Smash Bros Bu' and the card is cut off at the right edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Allow wrapping or a shorter display name, and give the last visible card enough padding so the name and image are not clipped.

issues.description: The last category chip ('Healthy') is cut off on the right, with only a sliver of the next chip visible.
issues.suggestion: Add end padding or a fade so the last fully visible chip isn't clipped, or make the scroll affordance clearer.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' promo card is cut off at the bottom by the tab bar, so the restaurant name and details are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset so the last card can scroll fully above the tab bar.
